rundown: Swarm beat Knicks 122-109 at Westchester County Center in White Plains, NY. Swarm led 61-53 at the half and never looked back. The 3rd quarter decided it: Swarm won it 39-28.
Leading the way — Swarm: Michael Ajayi 22 pts, 10 reb; Jarkel Joiner 7 ast. Knicks: Dalton Knecht 28 pts, 10 ast; Nick Jourdain 8 reb.
Where Swarm won it: they shot 42% from three to 30%, won the boards 46-32 and had 29 assists to 24.

review.title: The algo's call
review.body:
Logged before the start, last snapshot Nov 25, 6:56 PM ET. It had Swarm 62% and Knicks 38%, projecting Swarm 101.8 – Knicks 98.3 (200.1 total, Swarm by 3.5).

Final: Swarm 122 – Knicks 109. Right winner: it had Swarm at 62%.

review.title: How the ratings held up
review.body:
Swarm came in with a 11% above average attack and a 5% leakier than average defense (4-2, 110.5 scored and 102.7 allowed a game over 6 games), worth about 11 and 11 games of evidence. Projected to score 101.8, they scored 122 (+20.2 points, 20% over); projected to allow 98.3, they allowed 109 (+10.7 points, 11% over).

Knicks came in with a 7% above average attack and a 7% leakier than average defense (2-3, 102.8 scored and 108.6 allowed a game over 5 games), worth about 10 and 10 games of evidence. Projected to score 98.3, they scored 109 (+10.7 points, 11% over); projected to allow 101.8, they allowed 122 (+20.2 points, 20% over).

The bigger miss was Swarm's scoring (+20.2 points against projection); both sides outscored their projections, so the game ran hotter than either team's numbers said.

review.title: Where the result sat in the simulations
review.body:
Total: 231 against 200.1 projected (+30.9), about the 97th percentile of the simulated totals (a typical game swings ±16).

Margin: Swarm by 13 against Swarm by 3.5 projected, about the 21st percentile of the simulated margins (typical swing ±12).

An unusual result, but one the simulations saw regularly (roughly one game in six to one in twenty).

review.title: Situational factors, checked
review.body: Nothing situational moved this projection (rest, travel, form and conditions were all normal), so it came down to team strength.

review.title: Against the market
review.body: No line was priced for this game (no posted odds, or not enough data to price one).

review.title: What could have made it wrong
review.body:
Flagged going in: early-season numbers were thin; there were no odds to check the projection against.

The projection missed by a lot, so those flags likely mattered here.

review.title: What the algo learns
review.body:
This game's own lesson: scoring came in at ×1.176 of the raw projection, and the home side beat its projected margin by -10.7 points. It counts toward Hoops+ scoring level, home edge and both teams' attack and defense corrections.

Across 114 graded Hoops+ games the algo now scales scoring ×1.020 and gives home teams -1.2 points. Team corrections so far: Swarm attack ×0.976, defense ×0.964 (6 games); Knicks attack ×0.988, defense ×0.978 (5 games).

review.title: Bottom line
review.body: Right side, total outside its normal range, margin within its normal range, no bet.
